name: Thai Inspired Turkey-Mushroom Stir Fry with Spinach, Herbs & Rice

instructions.primary_message: Using a strainer or colander, rinse the rice under cold, running water, then drain and transfer to a medium saucepan. Add water and bring the mixture to a boil over high heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups jasmine rice
3 cup water

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg cremini mushrooms
3 limes
3 red chili peppers
2 small pkgs fresh mint
1 small bunch cilantro
1 ½ (142 g) pkgs baby spinach

instructions.primary_message: Once the liquid comes to a boil, stir the mixture, cover the saucepan, and reduce heat to low. Cook rice until liquid is fully absorbed, 15-18 minutes. Once done, remove rice from the heat and let it stand, still covered, for 5 minutes.
While the rice is cooking, roughly chop mushrooms. Place in a large bowl and set aside.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add turkey and salt; cook, breaking the meat apart with a spoon, until browned and crumbly, 5-6 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp neutral vegetable oil
1.02 kg ground turkey
3 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, juice limes into a small bowl.

Thinly slice chili peppers into rings and add to the bowl with the lime juice. (Be careful with chili peppers; do not touch your eyes and ensure you wash your hands after handling or wear gloves while preparing.)
Peel, halve, and mince onion. Add to the bowl, along with fish sauce and sugar, then stir to combine the sauce. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ medium red onion
⅓ cup fish sauce
1 ½ tbsp brown sugar

instructions.primary_message: When the turkey is done, add mushrooms to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until mushrooms start to brown, 6-8 minutes more.

Meanwhile, shave cilantro leaves off the stems; pick mint leaves off the stems. Discard stems and mince the leaves. Add half of the herbs to the bowl with the sauce. (Set remainder aside for serving.)
When the mushrooms are done, add sauce to the pot and stir to combine.
Add spinach to the pot in handfuls, waiting for it to wilt slightly before adding the next handful. Remove from heat.
To serve, divide rice and stir-fry between plates or bowls. Top with reserved herbs and enjoy!
